entry.title: Force Link Audio 1.1.0
entry.summary: ## Force Link Audio 1.1.0 — OpenMPC add-in Publish the Force's stereo main mix as a Link Audio channel while keeping the Force standalone. By Mac Digi / Rare Data, originally built for the COMPA project. This release adds the OpenMPC catalog package and shared installer. The audio tap stays small; the Link Audio publisher remains a separate process and now exits when its MPC parent exits. The build targets armhf/glibc 2.31; other MPC hardware is unverified. **Network audio is off by default.** R
